about.title: About the MCP server
about.body: The My Morning News MCP server lets Claude Code, Claude Desktop, an IDE, or your own agent list your topics, read briefings, dig into the evidence behind a finding, resolve predictions, act on suggestions, and give feedback with a reason.
about.privileges: It has no privileges of its own. Every call goes to the REST API with your access key, so your roles and ownership apply exactly as they do here. Feedback given through it is recorded with the channel MCP.

url.label: Streamable HTTP URL
url.help: The MCP server runs as its own process, separate from the REST API. Change this if yours runs elsewhere; the commands below follow it.
url.invalid: Enter an http or https URL.

key.title: Create an access key
key.body: Create an access key and secret for the MCP client, so you can revoke it later without changing your password. Copy the secret when it is created; it is shown only once.
key.authMode: Choose the Direct header or Hybrid auth mode: a Streamable HTTP client sends the key and secret on every request, which Signed requests and Session exchange keys refuse.
key.askAdmin: Access keys are created by an administrator. Ask yours for an access key with the Direct header auth mode.
